desc.zh: 同样是闪存颗粒，为什么换上 NVMe 协议和 PCIe 通道就能快出好几倍？八个交互模型带你从延迟拆解、总线宽度、64K 并行队列、环形门铃、NAND 多通道、写放大与 Trim、轮询与中断，一路走到 PCIe 6.0 与 GPUDirect 前沿。
desc.en: Why does switching from SATA/AHCI to NVMe over PCIe multiply storage speed? Eight interactive models trace the shift from latency breakdown, bus lanes, and 64K parallel queues to ring buffers, NAND channels, write amplification, polling, and PCIe 6.0 GPUDirect.

title.zh: NVMe 与存储协议开销转移

desc.zh: 闪存把介质延迟从 8.5 ms 降到 75 μs 后，旧协议 AHCI 的开销占比从 0.3% 飙升到 25% 以上；NVMe 将其压回 5 μs。
desc.en: Once flash cut media latency from 8.5 ms to 75 us, AHCI overhead jumped from 0.3% to 25%+; NVMe trims it back to ~5 us.

title.zh: PCIe 多车道与队列深度
title.en: PCIe Lanes and Little's Law in Storage

desc.zh: SATA III 有效极限仅 552 MB/s，而 PCIe 4.0/5.0/6.0 ×4 分别达到 7.1/14.2/28.5 GB/s；按利特尔法则，低队列深度仍跑不满宽总线。
desc.en: SATA III caps near 552 MB/s while PCIe 4.0/5.0/6.0 x4 reach 7.1/14.2/28.5 GB/s; by Little's Law, QD=1 still leaves wide buses idle.

zh: 队列深度 QD 是什么
en: why QD1 is slow on NVMe

desc.zh: AHCI 只有 1 条 32 槽位队列导致多核抢锁倒退；NVMe 支持 64K×64K 队列，每核独占队列实现线性扩展。
desc.en: AHCI's single 32-slot queue collapses under multicore spinlock contention; NVMe's 64K queues give each core a lock-free path.

zh: 为什么 NVMe IOPS 高

title.zh: 环形队列、门铃寄存器与 DMA

desc.zh: 主机内存里的 SQ/CQ 环形队列配合仅 2 次 Posted 门铃写与 PCIe DMA，消除 AHCI 的阻塞式 MMIO 读取。
desc.en: Host-RAM SQ/CQ ring buffers with posted doorbell writes and PCIe DMA eliminate AHCI's blocking uncached MMIO reads.

zh: NVMe 提交队列 完成队列

title.zh: SSD 多通道 NAND 并行

desc.zh: 单颗 NAND 读页需约 50 μs；主控通过 4–8 通道数十颗芯片并行交织，将并发吞吐推向百万 IOPS。
desc.en: A single NAND die takes ~50 us per read; striping across 4-8 channels and dozens of dies multiplies IOPS.

zh: 为什么 QD32 比 QD1 快

title.zh: 写放大、垃圾回收与 Trim

desc.zh: NAND 按页写按块擦，稳态写放大 WAF = 1/(1-v)；预留空间与 Trim 决定盘满时的持续写入速度。
desc.en: NAND writes in pages but erases in blocks; steady-state WAF = 1/(1-v) makes over-provisioning and Trim critical.

zh: 为什么 SSD 装满会变慢

title.zh: 轮询 vs 中断（io_uring / SPDK）

desc.zh: 10 μs 时代中断上下文切换开销占比剧增；高 IOPS 下忙轮询不仅降延迟，总 CPU 消耗也低于中断。
desc.en: At 10 us media latency, interrupt wakeups add huge overhead; above ~286k IOPS, busy polling saves both latency and CPU.

desc.zh: 2026 年企业级 PCIe 6.0 SSD 达 28 GB/s，GPUDirect Storage 绕过 CPU 内存直通 GPU 显存，ZNS 消除 FTL 写放大。
desc.en: 2026 enterprise PCIe 6.0 SSDs reach ~28 GB/s, GPUDirect Storage DMAs straight to GPU HBM, and ZNS removes FTL write amplification.
